title: An Empirical Analysis of Diversity in Argument Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (Key Point Generation and Matching) on low-frequency ('long tail') arguments versus high-frequency arguments by sorting key points by argument frequency and applying a cutoff parameter.

Measuring the correlation between human annotator agreement percentages and the models' predicted match scores to determine if models capture diverse subjective interpretations and disagreement rather than just aggregated consensus.

Assessing cross-dataset generalization and robustness by evaluating the performance of models across distinct datasets collected from different online debate platforms and citizen consultation contexts (ARGKP, PVE, PERSPECTRUM).
